target.title: refactor(plugins): decompose plugin registry
target.body:
Closes #105758

## What Problem This Solves

`createPluginRegistry` was a 3,577-line closure inside a 4,022-line module. Every plugin registration domain captured the same implicit mutable scope, making unrelated plugin work collide in one file and obscuring each domain's state and lifecycle dependencies.

## Why This Change Was Made

Replace the mega-closure with one typed registry state object and compose focused registrar modules for capabilities, tools/hooks, network/channel surfaces, providers, operations, host/session surfaces, and memory. The scoped plugin runtime proxy and plugin API builder now have explicit modules; `registry.ts` is the 130-line lifecycle composition root. Existing registry, plugin API, validation, rollback, and runtime ownership contracts are preserved.

## User Impact

No user-visible behavior change. Maintainers get smaller owner-specific review surfaces, explicit shared state, and fewer conflicts when extending separate plugin domains.

AI-assisted implementation; the complete patch was reviewed with the repository autoreview helper.

## Evidence

- Blacksmith Testbox through Crabbox: `tbx_01kxcbcnse4nqt5w0xkr9hjf30` (`harbor-krill-63eb`).
- Focused remote Vitest: 302 tests passed across registry, loader, captured registration, HTTP, provider/channel/control UI, host hooks, memory embedding, and session actions.
- Remote `pnpm check:changed`: core production and test tsgo, changed-file formatting, full core oxlint shards, plugin SDK baseline, import-cycle check, and repository guards passed.
- Exact CI follow-up: moved the existing session-accessor debt baseline from `registry.ts` to `registry-runtime.ts`; `node scripts/check-session-accessor-boundary.mjs` passed.
- Remote `pnpm build`: full runtime, plugin SDK declaration/export, asset, and Control UI build passed.
- Structured autoreview: `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode local --stream-engine-output` reported no accepted/actionable findings; correctness confidence 0.94.
- `src/plugins/registry.ts`: 4,022 lines before; 130 lines after.
- No changelog: internal refactor with no user-visible contract change.
